triggers.name: new_call
triggers.title: New call
triggers.help: Triggers on automation rules in Gong.io. To set this up, you will need to create an automation rule in Gong.io. Assign filters for this rule to match what calls you want to be picked up by this trigger. Endpoint URL Please connect to generate endpoint URL for Gong.io.

input.name: event_name
input.label: Event name
input.hint: Provide a unique event name to generate endpoint URL.

actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own Gong.io action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized with your Gong.io connection.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: add_call
actions.title: Add call
actions.help: To add a call, you will either need to provide a media download URL which Gong can download the file from or use the Add call media action after this to upload call media. Audio or video file in the media download URL must be a maximum of 1.5GB .

actions.name: add_call_media
actions.title: Add call media
actions.help: To upload call media, you will first need to add the call and its details via the Add call action. If uploading a dual-channel (stereo) file separated by speaker, make sure to specify which channel corresponds to the company team member (rep) in the parties input fields of the Add call action. input.name: id
input.label: Call ID
input.hint: The call ID returned from the Add call action.

actions.name: digital_interaction_action
actions.title: Post a digital interaction
actions.description: Create a digital interaction in Gong.io
actions.help: Post a digital interaction in Gong.io

actions.name: get_call_by_id
actions.title: Get call by ID
actions.description: Get call by ID in Gong.io
actions.help: Retrieves data for a specific call by Gong's unique ID.

input.name: id
input.label: Call ID
input.hint: Call ID to retrieve. ID can be found at the end of the URL.

actions.name: search_aggregated_user_data
actions.title: Search aggregated user data
actions.description: Search aggregated user data in Gong.io
actions.help: Lists the aggregated activity of multiple users within the Gong system for each time period within the defined date range. This endpoint returns multiple records, one for each user. For each user there are items for every time period in the date range, including statistics about the user's activity.…

input.name: aggregationPeriod
input.label: Aggregation period
input.hint: Calendar time period for aggregating data. First day of the week is Monday . Select No aggregation to return user data aggregated by the date range you provide.

actions.name: search_call_scorecards
actions.title: Search call scorecards
actions.help: Retrieves all the answers for the scorecards that were reviewed during a specified date range, for calls that took place during a specified date range, for specific scorecards or for specific reviewed users.

actions.name: search_call_transcripts
actions.title: Search call transcripts
actions.help: Lists the transcripts of calls that took place during a specified date range and have specified call IDs.

actions.name: search_calls
actions.title: Search calls
actions.help: Lists detailed call data for calls that took place during a specified date range and have specified call IDs.

actions.name: search_users
actions.title: Search users
actions.help: Search for users in Gong via their Gong internal IDs.
